title: CAPE: A Chinese Dataset for Appraisal-based Emotional Generation using Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on emotion generation and prediction in Large Language Models based on Cognitive Appraisal Theory. While it includes 'moral or ethical issues' as one of the 89 situational factors used to generate the dataset, the paper does not have a core component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
